subject: Open Beacon sprint — package ask: compute trial + co-marketing
messages:
--- Message 1 (2027-03-12 09:14 - Samira Khan <samira@openbeacon.org>) ---
From: Samira Khan <samira@openbeacon.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood partner package for Open Beacon Sprint (Apr 16-18)

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Quick ask: Open Beacon is running a three-day community sprint (Apr 16–18) focused on tooling and docs contributions for verified-open projects. We had a few hundred signups last year; this year we expect ~250 active participants, ~30 mentor/maintainer sessions.

We'd love Redwood to participate with a small developer package that covers:
- Compute credits for maintainers (approx. 300k token-equivalent, rough estimate)
- 3 trial extensions for mentor teams (90 days)
- A co-marketing promo credit ($2k equivalent) to run in our sponsor shoutouts and the pre-sprint newsletter

Attached is a short brief and our CFP/mentor roster. Major asks: can we confirm by Mar 19 so we can list Redwood on the site and lock mentor slots?

Happy to hop on 20-min call if that helps.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Head of Community, Open Beacon
attachments: openbeacon-sprint-brief.pdf (PDF, 420KB); openbeacon-cfp.xlsx (spreadsheet)

--- Message 2 (2027-03-12 10:02 - Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@openbeacon.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood partner package for Open Beacon Sprint (Apr 16-18)

Hi Samira —
Really excited about this — Open Beacon is a great fit for the maintainer program. A couple quick clarifying Qs so I can route internally:
- Do you need the compute credits pooled for maintainers (we issue access codes) or per-project keys?
- Approx breakdown: how many mentor teams would get the 90-day trials vs. full maintainer grants?
- Any logo placement / sponsor tier expectations for the $2k promo?

If you can share the mentor roster link (or a short counts table) I'll add the recommended package to the internal ask. I can run this past the grants committee this afternoon if you can confirm details.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Partnerships — Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 (2027-03-12 11:09 - Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood partner package for Open Beacon Sprint (Apr 16-18)

Marissa / Soojin / Grace —
Forwarding Open Beacon's brief. They asked us for a small sponsor package: compute credits for maintainers (~300k token eq.), three 90-day trial extensions for mentor teams, and a $2k promo credit for co-marketing.

My suggested ask to the grants/marketing pool:
- Maintainer compute pool: 300k token-equivalent (provision as a single pooled code for maintainers)
- Mentor trials: 3 x 90-day trial activations (we already have a trial-extension workflow)
- Co-marketing promo: $2,000 in promo credit redeemable against paid ad or newsletter slots (marketing to confirm)

Business notes: Open Beacon is primarily EU/US community, strong signal for maintainer engagement and new OSS integrations. This is fairly low-cost but high-signal for the community ledger. They need confirmation by Mar 19 to show Redwood as sponsor on website.

Can we greenlight these? Marissa, any objections on marketing side? Soojin, can grants cover the compute pool vs. partnership credit? Grace, can community ops handle onboarding?

Thanks —
Ben

--- Message 4 (2027-03-13 16:22 - Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodai.com>) ---
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood partner package for Open Beacon Sprint (Apr 16-18)

Thanks for the context, Ben. I'm ok to approve the following from the grants budget:
- Provision a pooled compute credit code equivalent to ~300k tokens (valid for 120 days from issuance).
- Issue 3 trial-extension tokens (90 days) for mentor teams; community can manage assignment.
- Marketing: we'll earmark $2,000 in promo credit — Marissa, please confirm how the credit shows up in our sponsor slate / newsletter inventory.

Grace: please prepare an onboarding snippet and a short promo blurb we can hand to Samira. Ben: I'll create the grant record (RBW-OPB-2027-004) and route for a quick signature.

No objections from finance on spend. Once Marissa confirms promo mechanics we'll share the codes and a one-page onboarding doc.

Soojin Lee
Head of Grants & Community Programs — Redwood Inference
